description: This file defines the main activity for an Android Tic Tac Toe game, managing UI components, game interactions, and state persistence.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing the Tic Tac Toe game UI and interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI, restores game state if available, and sets up event listeners for game cells and reset button.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves current game state into the bundle for state restoration.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Updates UI components based on current game state, including cell texts, enablement, and background.

methods.name: showResultSnackbar
methods.description: Displays a snackbar with the game result and provides a reset action.
